rows.missing_source_or_test: A complete per-configuration valve/bladder bill and an independent coverage/selection check after carrying it into the named least-optimism witnesses.
rows.detail: P2's R12/95% witness uses lowe_night at design -10 hPa, and R20/99% uses mask3 lowe_night at -20 hPa. They differ from the static AlAOC rows repriced here. Those AlAOC rows fall to 94.156% and 98.960%, but this does not prove a new minimum radius across all finishes/subsets. P3 also needs its matched standard-pressure bladder.

rows.missing_source_or_test: An independent constrained-search comparison over the stated eight factors and two thicknesses, with feasible witnesses and numerical tolerances.
rows.detail: The all-density candidate independently closes the supplied bill and its factor product matches. This spot review does not reproduce the ranking against every mixed candidate. 061 itself correctly labels the result best feasible found, not a global-optimality certificate; this is not a demonstrated owner error.

rows.missing_source_or_test: A validated residual-stress field and buckling calculation establishing how cure mismatch enters global demand.
rows.detail: The frozen and new numerical accounts reproduce separately. Treat the cure-compression denominator as the declared scenario, not a proved correction to installed-hull mechanics.

rows.missing_source_or_test: Installed Be-skin optical, mass, adhesion, aging, wet-surface and thermal-cycle evidence, including the switchable finish.
rows.detail: Sheldahl's alpha<=0.14 and epsilon<=0.05 specifications concern an aluminized polyimide film with acrylic protection. Holding 8.33 g/m2 while transferring those optics to Be is already disclosed as a projection. The numerical thermal shift is reproducible, not qualified hardware.

rows.missing_source_or_test: A chronological air-admission/ballast/ground-service mission model and corresponding physical evidence, plus P3's cold and humidity limits.
rows.detail: The independent recount preserves the hourly best-of-trim/climb rule. Admitted air cannot be removed in flight, so independent hourly feasibility is not mission availability. Gusts outside the design, precipitation, hail, icing and lightning are excluded. Missing weather days are excluded from the denominator.

rows.missing_source_or_test: Qualified replacement-face, core, joints and full-member/frame data, including coupled thermal and density properties.
rows.detail: A lower face-density factor is a synthetic material target at fixed mechanics and thermal constants, not a reduction in elemental Be density. The P3 impossibility bound applies only to the named levers and constant-g/R family.

rows.missing_source_or_test: A full independent raw-record selection and quality-flag audit if the processed ten-year dataset is to be qualified.
rows.detail: This review checks all processed-hour/day counts and 24 raw NOAA observations. It does not claim to independently reproduce the complete NOAA conversion pipeline.
